The Company

Founded in 2009 by Audrey McLoghlin, Frank & Eileen set out to reinvent the women's button-up using the finest Italian fabrics often reserved for menswear. Named in honor of Audrey's beloved Irish grandparents, the brand has grown slowly and intentionally into a woman-owned, woman-led leader in sustainability and slow fashion. After seventeen years of steady growth through wholesale partnerships and direct-to-consumer e-commerce, Frank & Eileen recently opened its first US flagship store—an Irish country house on Madison Avenue, NYC. This new chapter continues the brand's legacy of using entrepreneurship as a force for good while delivering generationless style to its beloved community of customers—all from our HQ in sunny California.

Frank & Eileen is looking for a Head of Customer to lead and unify our customer service strategy, launch a new digital clienteling program, and evolve our loyalty program. jobs.title: Director of Performance Analysis & Simulation
jobs.descriptionText:
About The Company

We are a stealth-mode Aerospace & Defense startup headquartered in Gardena, CA. Our founding team hails from SpaceX, Anduril, and Lockheed Martin, and we are backed by Joint Staff-level military leadership and several Silicon Valley firms. With a world-class business development & leadership team already in place, we are well positioned to capitalize on already overwhelming demand.

Job Overview

We’re seeking an exceptional Director of Performance Analysis & Simulation to own the technical backbone of our defense system’s development cycle — from early conceptual design through flight qualification. This is a senior individual contributor and people leadership role simultaneously: you will build and lead a team of aerodynamicists, systems analysis software engineers, and simulation engineers while remaining deeply hands-on in the work yourself, with an outsized role in informing vehicle, system, and program design. You will own our Systems Analysis Board process, drive simulation fidelity improvements from real flight data, and be a central technical voice at every major design review from CODR through CDR.

This is a full time role at a fast-growing stealth startup with a significant equity opportunity. The need for the capability we are building is at an inflection point in the United States and around the world — execution in this role will directly lead to systems deployed that protect civilians and bring warfighters home. The right person for this role will find no better environment to do the most technically demanding and consequential work of their career.

Key Responsibilities



-  Own the Systems Analysis Board end-to-end: conceptual design trade studies, design sensitivity analyses, Monte Carlo campaigns for CEP and Pk as designs mature, and cross-disciplinary coordination at CODR, PDR, and CDR
-  Architect and continuously improve a high-fidelity 6-DOF simulation environment spanning aerodynamics, propulsion, GNC, seeker performance, target modeling, and radar modeling — built in Python, not Excel
-  Drive closed-loop simulation fidelity improvement using flight test data; define instrumentation and data collection requirements to support this process
-  Lead Multidisciplinary Design Analysis and Optimization (MDAO) efforts across the vehicle design space, working directly with propulsion, aero, GNC, and seeker teams
-  Define and iterate on system-level performance requirements; translate operational requirements into traceable engineering parameters
-  Contribute directly to RFP response material, new product concept modeling, and customer-facing performance characterization
-  Build, lead, and mentor a team of aerodynamicists, systems analysis software engineers, and simulation engineers; set technical standards and drive a culture of rigor and speed
-  Expected to own large technical outcomes and operate with the autonomy and accountability of a company-level leader reporting to the CEO, not a functional manager

Qualifications



-  Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field
-  10+ years of hands-on systems analysis, simulation, or performance engineering experience in defense, missile, or aerospace programs
-  Demonstrated ownership of flight vehicle simulation development — you have personally written and validated 6-DOF or higher-fidelity simulations in Python or equivalent production-quality code, not wrapped legacy tools
-  Deep working knowledge across at least four of the following domains: aerodynamics, solid rocket propulsion, GNC, seeker/sensor modeling, radar cross-section and target modeling, flight mechanics, lethality and Pk analysis
-  Direct experience with Monte Carlo analysis for CEP and kill probability across a design maturation cycle
-  Hands-on experience with MDAO frameworks and design space exploration at the vehicle system level
-  Experience owning or leading major design reviews (PDR, CDR) in a flight hardware program
-  Demonstrated ability to set system-level performance requirements from first principles and defend them under scrutiny from both engineers and customers
-  Proven track record as a strong individual contributor who also builds and elevates teams — this is not a purely managerial role

Preferred Skills



-  Master’s or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
-  Experience at a high-velocity defense or aerospace organization
-  Background in missile system performance analysis
-  Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) or software-in-the-loop (SWIL) simulation integration
-  Familiarity with radar phenomenology, seeker discrimination, or EO/IR target modeling
-  Prior contribution to government RFP responses, CDRL deliverables, or program-of-record performance documentation
-  Experience deriving simulation fidelity improvements directly from flight test telemetry and reconstruction
-  Comfort operating at the intersection of classified program requirements and fast-moving commercial development processes

Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. How we invest and partner will shape the ecosystem around USDC, programmable money, and next-generation financial infrastructure. This role combines strategy, program design, driving investor influence, venture investing, and ecosystem leadership; defining the brand, systems, and investment theses; sourcing and executing high-conviction investments; and converting portfolio relationships into durable strategic advantage for Circle.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience building and leading venture investment programs (e.g. the Arc Builders Fund), alongside a nuanced understanding of fintech, crypto, and emerging financial infrastructure. Equally important are strong communication skills (written and oral), executive presence, cross-functional influence, and the ability to translate market insight into actionable strategy, building not just a portfolio, but a systematic engine that extends Circle’s reach and impact across the global digital economy.

- Deliver best-in-class strategic insight and deal execution through analytical rigor, sound judgment, operational excellence, scalable systems, and appropriate hustle.
- Collaborate across Circle to align priorities, surface strong decisions, and drive measurable impact.
- Build and maintain a powerful network of founders, funds, and ecosystem leaders to expand Circle’s opportunity and access to information.
- Generate insights that clarify where and how Circle teams can engage for maximum strategic leverage.
- Use emerging technologies and structured processes to detect signals in the noise—and convert insight into action.
- Raise the bar through candid feedback, mentorship, and continuous improvement in how we operate together.

What You'll Work On

- Designing new strategic initiatives that align with Circle's product and commercial roadmap.
- Transforming our network of 140+ portfolio companies into a structured "knowledge engine," turning unstructured insights into actionable alpha. 
- Owning the pre- and post-investment lifecycle, building cross-functional workflows between our Business, Legal, Marketing, and Developer Relations teams.
- Building investment theses and other content that informs our approach and communications.

jobs.descriptionText:

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance



- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About The Team

UX Research at Angi is embedded in a multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers, and content creators. We build experiences that span both sides of a two-sided marketplace — homeowners navigating big decisions and service professionals growing their businesses — across digital and in-person touchpoints.

We're in a meaningful growth period. This isn't a role focused solely on optimizing existing flows. We're building new product surfaces, exploring new experience models, and using research to identify opportunities we haven't yet named. If you're energized by working in ambiguous, early-stage problem spaces and helping a team build from a strong point of view, this is a good team for you.

About The Role

This is a rare opportunity to do two kinds of research that most roles force you to choose between.

On one side, you'll co-define and execute blue sky and strategic discovery work alongside research leadership — exploring future-state opportunities, emerging user needs, and experience spaces that don't have a roadmap item yet. This is generative, open-ended work where the question is often as important as the answer, and where your instincts about what's worth exploring will matter as much as your ability to run a clean study.

On the other side, you'll own a portfolio of customer experience metrics programs — tracking how users feel and behave across key moments in the Angi journey, measuring the impact of product changes over time, and building the longitudinal understanding that keeps the team grounded in what's actually happening for customers.

Together, these two workstreams give you something unusual: real influence at the front edge of product strategy, and the satisfaction of watching your research drive decisions you can measure. You'll report directly to the VP of Research — which means a short path to the conversations that matter and a genuine opportunity to shape how the research function evolves.

What you'll do



- Independently scope and execute research studies based on product decisions and risks — choosing methods that balance rigor and speed, and adjusting when conditions change
- Work across multiple data sources: qualitative interviews, usability sessions, concept tests, lightweight surveys, and secondary research
- Participate in and support generative and discovery research — concept testing, opportunity framing, early-stage exploration — where the question isn't fully defined yet
- Synthesize across sessions to identify root causes and motivations, not just surface-level patterns; produce insights grounded in repeated behavior, context, and meaning
- Connect insights to near-term roadmap decisions and help partners understand user tradeoffs alongside business constraints
- Communicate findings clearly to product, design, and engineering partners — distilling complexity into what matters most and what to do about it
- Present to cross-functional partners and occasional director-level stakeholders with confidence and clarity
- Use AI tools to accelerate synthesis and research operations (tagging, clustering, transcription, repository management) while validating outputs for accuracy
- Contribute to team practice: share reusable frameworks, improve templates, mentor junior researchers on craft and process
- Build trusted relationships with product and design partners within your zone

Who you are



- 4–6 years of UX research experience, with a combination of consultancy/innovation firm experience and in-house product work
- Your consultancy or design firm experience gave you: comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 spaces; a habit of working with stakeholders who aren't sure what they need; and confidence forming and defending a point of view with limited data
- Your in-house product experience gave you: familiarity with how product roadmaps, sprint cycles, and metrics work; an understanding of how research earns trust and gets used in a fast-moving team; and a track record of insights that influenced real decisions
- Skilled in qualitative methods (interviews, diary studies, concept testing, usability testing) with growing comfort in quantitative approaches (surveys, behavioral data analysis, A/B interpretation)
- You scope studies independently and choose methods that fit the question — not the other way around
- You synthesize across sessions to find root causes, not just recurring quotes; your insights say something about why, not just what
- Strong, clear communicator — you can write a sharp one-pager, structure a crisp readout, and present to a skeptical PM or design lead without losing them
- Collaborative and reliable — partners know what to expect from you, you manage expectations proactively, and you raise blockers early
- Curious about home ownership, home improvement, and what it means to help people find reliable help for something as personal as where they live
- Comfortable working in AI-assisted workflows and interested in doing research on AI-powered product experiences as we build them

- Define and execute the R&D strategy aligned with overall business goals.

- Establish metrics and processes to evaluate R&D effectiveness and ROI.

- Proven experience leading R&D or innovation functions in a technology-driven organization.
- Strong track record of bringing new products or technologies from concept to market.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term innovation with near-term business needs.
- Advanced degree in a relevant technical field preferred.
